newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall slightly.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 48.46 percent from 48.56 percent at the last sale on January 4, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 8.68 million UAH 55.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.75 million UAH 49.94 million UAH
The central bank sold 86,881 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 69,604 were competitive and 17,277 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.23 percent from 59.33 percent at the last sale on January 4, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 26.76 million UAH 36.92 million UAH
Actual amount raised 20.66 million UAH 28.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 267,644 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 253,588 were competitive and 14,056 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 61.25 percent from 61.34 percent at the last sale on January 4, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 23.01 million UAH 22.54 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.78 million UAH 15.45 million UAH
The central bank sold 230,099 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 223,099 were competitive and 7,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 10.
